sections.heading: About Verdant
sections.lead: Verdant is a small-batch organic skincare brand in Somerset, known for its nourishing and effective products.

items.title: Our Story
items.text: Founded by Sarah and Tom, Verdant has been making natural skincare since 2015.

items.title: Our Mission
items.text: To provide high-quality organic skincare that is gentle on the skin and good for the planet.

items.title: Our Values
items.text: We believe in transparency, sustainability, and ethical practices in all aspects of our business.

sections.heading: Selected Products
sections.lead: Experience the power of organic skincare with our six products.

items.title: Cream
items.text: A luxurious cream that nourishes and hydrates your skin.

items.title: Sage
items.text: A refreshing toner that balances the skin's pH and soothes irritation.

items.title: Rose Petal
items.text: A floral essence that brightens your complexion and calms sensitive skin.

items.title: Cactus Oil
items.text: A rich oil that nourishes and protects the skin from environmental stressors.

items.title: Ginger Extract
items.text: A warming extract that boosts circulation and reduces inflammation.

items.title: Mint Oil
items.text: A refreshing oil that soothes the skin and promotes relaxation.

sections.heading: Our Skills
sections.lead: We are skilled in creating natural skincare products that are safe for your skin and the environment.

items.title: Organic Ingredients
items.text: All of our products are made with 100% organic ingredients.

items.title: Sustainable Practices
items.text: We use sustainable practices in all aspects of our business, from sourcing materials to packaging.

items.title: Ethical Business Practices
items.text: We believe in transparency and ethical practices in all aspects of our business.
